title: feat(console): marketplace facet filters and a Beta badge from the spec taxonomy
body:
domain:ui#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5oQ9zXD1QMdHFaqv1J
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XDp4MDE5jLtwYunGcCVPt5v)_

Fixes #31011

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no file under `skills/**` teaches the `marketplace.category` keys or the console's marketplace filters (`git grep -i "marketplace\.category"` over `skills/` and `content/docs/`: 0 hits); `content/docs/deployment/marketplace-handbook.mdx` says the console's facet chips and Beta badge arrive as each side adopts the taxonomy and a declared value is not yet shown, which stays true until the catalog serves the columns.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:控制台市场页的单排「分类」小标签换成三个筛选维度:类型(应用 / 模板 / 连接器,单选,带「全部」)、职能、行业(可多选)。同一维度内是「或」,维度之间是「且」,每个取值后面显示数量。卡片显示主职能和 Beta 徽标,详情页显示全部职能、行业、类型和 Beta。
- 为什么改:旧分类已在 spec 里退役(#30904 的分类方案裁决),控制台还在读 `category`,翻译表也是旧枚举的手抄副本。现在取值直接来自 `@objectstack/spec/marketplace` 的枚举,翻译键按枚举值生成,有测试保证每个值都有翻译,不再另存一份列表。
- 破坏性:`@object-ui/i18n` 删除 `marketplace.category.*` 这组翻译键(旧分类枚举的副本),所以按 Clause-② 声明为 narrowing,changeset 里有 BREAKING 段(FROM / TO / 修法)和 ADR-0087 的 `not-required (runtime-interface-only …)` 处置标记。版本级别仍是 patch。
- 风险与回滚:cloud 目录在 objectstack-ai/cloud#3661 上线前不带这些字段,这期间所有筛选都隐藏,页面就是不带筛选栏的卡片列表(旧的分类小标签也一并去掉)。筛选仍在客户端,只覆盖已加载的 100 条。回滚即 revert。
- 先看:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/marketplaceTaxonomy.ts`(筛选语义与「无数据即隐藏」),`MarketplaceFacetFilters.tsx`,`ui/packages/i18n/src/__tests__/marketplace-taxonomy-labels-31011.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/__tests__/MarketplacePage.facets-31011.test.tsx`,预期 `Tests 11 passed (11)`。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **Facet filters** (`MarketplacePage.tsx`, new `MarketplaceFacetFilters.tsx`, new `marketplaceTaxonomy.ts`). The category chip row is replaced by three facets read from `@objectstack/spec/marketplace`: `solutionType` as a segment with All, `businessFunctions` and `industries` as toggle rows. OR inside a facet, AND across facets and with the search box. Each value shows the count of loaded listings carrying it under the other facets' selection. The values are the spec schemas' `.options`, in the spec's order; a value is drawn when a loaded listing carries it (or it is selected), so the buttons do not jump while filtering. A facet that no loaded listing carries is not drawn: with no taxonomy on the wire there is no filter row at all, and industries hide while no listing carries one. A listing that declares no solution type is counted and filtered as `app` (`DEFAULT_SOLUTION_TYPE`, the spec's reading of an absent key). A taxonomy column that is not an array reads as no values: its facet hides and the page still renders.
- **Badges.** A catalog card shows the primary business function (the first the listing names) and a Beta badge when `maturity === 'beta'`. The Details page (`MarketplacePackagePage.tsx`) shows every business function in the listing's order, the industries, the solution type (the declared one, or `app` when none is declared, as the catalog counts it), and the Beta badge, each facet as a labelled group.
- **Raw-value fallback dropped.** The old `categoryLabel` fell back to the category's raw spelling when no label existed. A facet value now has to be a spec value to be drawn anywhere; a row carrying anything else draws nothing for it.
- **Wire** (`marketplaceApi.ts`). `MarketplacePackageSummary` declares `business_functions`, `industries`, `solution_type` and `maturity`, typed by the spec's taxonomy types, and drops `category`. `listMarketplacePackages` drops its `category` parameter, which had no caller.
- **i18n** (`ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/marketplace/*.ts`, 10 hand-written catalogues plus `zh-Hant` regenerated by `gen:zh-hant`). `marketplace.category.*` (the copy of the retired enum) is deleted. Added: `marketplace.businessFunction.*` (11), `marketplace.industry.*` (10), `marketplace.solutionType.*` (3), `marketplace.maturity.beta`, and three facet headings `marketplace.facet.*`.
- **Call-site key gate** (`ui/scripts/check-i18n-call-site-keys.mjs`). The `marketplace.category.` dynamic family is gone, so its `DYNAMIC_KEY_FAMILIES` entry would read stale; three new heads would read undeclared. The entry is replaced by `marketplace.businessFunction.`, `marketplace.industry.` and `marketplace.solutionType.`, each `enumerable: false` / `why: 'external-vocabulary'` (the vocabulary is a spec enum this reader cannot open), and each reason names the parity test that pins the set. The gate itself is unchanged. One comment in `dead-pack-keys-retired-8754.test.ts` that named the retired head now names a live one.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/31011-marketplace-taxonomy-facets.md`: `@object-ui/i18n` (published, its catalogues ship in `dist`) and `@object-ui/app-shell` patch, `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. Removing `marketplace.category.*` from a published package's catalogues narrows what a consumer can read, so the changeset carries a **BREAKING** paragraph (FROM the 15 removed keys; TO no one-for-one replacement, the facet keys `marketplace.businessFunction|industry|solutionType.*` and `LEGACY_CATEGORY_MAPPING` in `@objectstack/spec/marketplace`; the one-line fix) and exactly one ADR-0087 disposition, `not-required (runtime-interface-only ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/marketplace/index.ts#MarketplaceCatalogue)`, whose spelling `scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs` accepts ("1 declared-breaking changeset(s), each carrying an ADR-0087 disposition", exit 0).

## Why

The maintainer's taxonomy ruling on #30904 (「关掉，Beta 并入分类方案」 and D1–D3) retired the single `category` for three facets and a maturity flag, and PR #30980 landed them in the spec. The console still built its chips from `category`, and its labels copied the retired enum, so a value cloud served outside that copy was shown as its raw spelling.

## Tests

- New `MarketplacePage.facets-31011.test.tsx` (11 cases). Every click goes through the rendered buttons (`fireEvent`), `fetch` is stubbed by path with the catalog body, and labels are the `en` pack's: spec-order facets with counts; OR inside a facet; AND across facets with counts against the other facets; the solution-type segment including the default `app` and All; search plus facets; no taxonomy draws no filter and no badge; industries and type hide while only business functions are served; off-spec values (`crm`, `general`, `theme`) drawn nowhere; the card's primary-function badge; Beta on `beta` only; a list column that is not an array (`business_functions: 'finance'`, `industries: {…}`) reads as no values and the catalog still renders.
- New `MarketplacePackagePage.taxonomy-31011.test.tsx` (4 cases): every business function in order, industries, type and Beta; a stable listing with no industries; a listing with no taxonomy draws the default solution type `app` and nothing else; off-spec values and list columns that are not arrays are drawn nowhere.
- New `ui/packages/i18n/src/__tests__/marketplace-taxonomy-labels-31011.test.ts` (57 cases): for each of the 11 marketplace catalogues and each of `MarketplaceBusinessFunctionSchema` / `MarketplaceIndustrySchema` / `MarketplaceSolutionTypeSchema`, every `.options` value has a non-empty label and no other key is labelled; `maturity` labels `beta` alone; no catalogue keeps `category`. The catalogue set is held equal to `MARKETPLACE_LANGUAGE_CODES`.
- **Ablations** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each anchor hit once, each restore proven blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty; the tests import the edited files as source, so no build sits on the path). See Verification.

## Acceptance notes

- **Expected 5 is not in this PR** (seat ruling): server-side filtering and the dead `?category=` filter in `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-proxy-plugin.ts` go to a sibling card the seat files. Filtering here stays on the client over the `limit: 100` page.
- **Wire shape is an assumption until objectstack-ai/cloud#3661 ships.** The reader expects `business_functions` and `industries` as JSON arrays of spec values (the spec's shape for the camelCase keys) and `solution_type` / `maturity` as strings. Until the catalog serves them every facet hides, as the card says.
- **Off-spec values.** The cloud catalog stores the facets as select fields whose options are the spec's, so an off-spec value should not reach the console; if one does it is drawn nowhere rather than as its raw spelling. Not a tolerance shim: nothing is mapped or aliased.
- **Detail page solution type.** An undeclared type is drawn as `app` (`DEFAULT_SOLUTION_TYPE`), the same reading the catalog's filter and counts use, so the two pages agree.
- **Filter state is component state**, as the category filter and the search box were; nothing moved to the URL.
- **Test fixtures still carrying `category`** in eight older marketplace tests (most of them org-catalog rows, whose `OrgPackageSummary.category` is untouched) were left as they are: they are untyped literals that nothing reads.
- **Locale count.** The order named nine namespace locales; the tree has eleven marketplace catalogues (ten hand-written plus the generated `zh-Hant`), all updated.
- **`zh` Beta label.** `untranslated-identity-4376.test.ts` refuses an English value verbatim in a non-Latin pack, so `zh-Hans` reads `测试版` (`zh-Hant` `測試版`); the other non-Latin packs translate it too.

## Verification

All at head `2296ac23` (base `8ef4d309`; it merges cleanly onto `origin/main` `66bf5b4a`). Heavy runs went through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`. Round 1 ran on `4f2029f9`; every run below was repeated on `2296ac23`.

<details><summary>Package suites and type-check</summary>

- Prerequisite: `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' --filter '@object-ui/i18n^...' build`, VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/ packages/i18n/`: Test Files 156 passed (156), Tests 2313 passed | 13 skipped (2326). The first run on `b3457e91` had one red, `untranslated-identity-4376.test.ts` (`zh-Hans` / `zh-Hant` `marketplace.maturity.beta` was the English `Beta`); `4f2029f9` translates it.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` (each runs `tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, which includes the new tests): both Done, VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Round 1 also ran `pnpm --dir ui exec eslint` over the touched source and test files: exit 0, 0 errors (55 warnings, all `no-explicit-any` in the pre-existing page and API files).

</details>

<details><summary>Dogfood battery</summary>

- `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@objectstack/dogfood^...' build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the lock: Test Files 435 passed | 3 skipped (438), Tests 3609 passed | 41 skipped (3650), VERDICT command-exit 0. No failures.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (10, each red, each restored)</summary>

Each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`; the anchor hit once, the mutation was proven on disk by anchor count and blob change, and the restore by blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty. The tests read the edited files as source, so no build sits on the path. A1 to A8 ran on `4f2029f9`; A9 and A10 cover this round's changes and ran on `2296ac23`.

| # | Mutation | Red |
|:--|:--|:--|
| A1 | OR inside business function turned into every-of (`.some` to `.every`) | facets test 2 failed / 8 passed (OR, AND) |
| A2 | the industry selection ignored | 1 failed / 9 passed (AND) |
| A3 | Beta for any maturity but `stable` | 3 failed / 10 passed across both page files (Beta only for beta, no-taxonomy cases) |
| A4 | every spec value drawn whether or not a listing carries it | 4 failed / 6 passed (spec-order facets, both hide cases, off-spec) |
| A5 | the off-spec filter on business functions removed | 2 failed / 11 passed (off-spec drawn nowhere, page and Details) |
| A6 | an undeclared solution type not read as `app` | 2 failed / 8 passed (counts, segment) |
| A7 | `en` `marketplace.businessFunction.legal` deleted (a spec value with no label) | parity test 1 failed / 56 passed |
| A8 | `en` labels a value the spec does not list (`crm`) | parity test 1 failed / 56 passed |
| A9 | the `Array.isArray` guard in `readListingTaxonomy` removed (a column trusted as a list) | 2 failed / 13 passed across both page files (the non-array cases on the catalog and on Details) |
| A10 | Details draws only a declared solution type | detail test 2 failed / 2 passed (no taxonomy draws `app`; off-spec and non-array) |

A8's first attempt was refused by the tool before running (its replacement contained the anchor); it was rerun with a distinct replacement, and the reading above is the rerun.

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates (dispatch-gates --commands, 38 families)</summary>

- 38 run, all exit 0. `dispatch-gates.mjs --ran`: "38 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 38 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED".
- Two of them did not measure on the first pass and were rerun under the lock. `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` was killed with SIGKILL when memory ran out beside the dogfood build, and `pnpm check:type-check-debt` exited 3 (the lock queue timed out, so nothing was built). On the rerun, `vitest run scripts/` (which holds the call-site key gate's own suite) gave Test Files 170 passed | 2 skipped (172), Tests 4996 passed | 2 skipped (4998). `check:type-check-debt` re-measured 0 ledger entries, with 0 raw tsc errors.
- Run beyond the derivation, all exit 0: `pnpm --dir ui run check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check:new-line-citations`.
- `node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main`: "1 declared-breaking changeset(s), each carrying an ADR-0087 disposition", exit 0.

</details>

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (Not touched.)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
